name: Doctor Bong

abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Heavy Proficiency: Ağır saldırılar sırasında saldırı gücünü belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Reverb: Bu şampiyonun vuruşları, verilen hasara dayalı ek fiziksel hasar patlaması verir.
abilityDetails.Panic: Etkilenen şampiyonlar Kaçış (Evade) yapamaz veya saldırıları ıskalatamaz.
abilityDetails.Reversal: Uygulayan şampiyondaki Stun etkilerini kaldırır, gelen saldırıyı durdurur ve rakibi yere seren sert bir karşı vuruşla misilleme yapar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Combo'yu orta/hafif vuruşla bitirirsen ters çevirme (inversion) uygular ve seni yere serer — kimse buna immün değil, asla combo bitirme. %20 şansla hasar debuff'larını purify eder, pasif efektli şampiyon tercih et.
signatureAbility:
Ask Not For Whom the Bong Tolls
When Doctor Bong would be struck by a Combo-Ending Attack, he executes a Reversal. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
Doctor Bong's Heavy Proficiency Buff gains [10 - 25]% increased potency.
immunityDetails:
• Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı 🔮
• İğne (Power Sting) Bağışıklığı 🐝
• %20 Arındırma 💪🏼

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: The incomparable Doctor Bong is Immune to Nullify and Power Sting.
As a genius, Doctor Bong fights using his head. Charging a Heavy Attack grants him an Unblockable Buff until the end of his Heavy or Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Purify
content: For each Debuff on him, Doctor Bong has a 20% chance to Purify incoming Debuffs, increased to 50% against non-Damaging Debuffs. Doctor Bong can't Purify Stun Debuffs.
When Doctor Bong Purifies a Debuff, he gains +5 Combo.

abilitySections.title: Guaranteed Critical Hits
content: After Doctor Bong's Combo Meter reaches a multiple of 5, he gains an indefinite Guaranteed Critical Passive.
When Doctor Bong Critically Hits with a Basic Attack, he loses 1 personal Guaranteed Critical Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Activating a Special Attack grants Doctor Bong a +[11,088] Heavy Proficiency Buff for 30 seconds. This will not re-trigger while active and expires 80% slower during the Opponent's Special Attacks, but expires 10% faster for each active personal Reverb.
Doctor Bong bongs his bell 3 times in each Special Attack. Each bong grants him an indefinite 8.35% Reverb Buff per level of the Special.
Gaining these Reverbs restores 5 seconds to Doctor Bong's Heavy Proficiency's duration. Critical Hits restore 3 seconds. When the Heavy Proficiency ends, all personal Reverbs are removed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - A Bell Is No Bell 'Til You Bong It
content: On activation, inflict a Panic Debuff for 20 seconds. Critical Hits restore 5 seconds to this duration.
While at 9 or more Reverbs, the final hit inflicts a Stun Debuff for a fixed 1.8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Bong Me Up
content: Each of the 5 hits grants Doctor Bong +5 additional Combo Meter.
While at 9 or more Reverbs, the final hit inflicts a Stun Debuff for a fixed 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Ballistiographic Oscillating Newtonian Gigahertz (B.O.N.G.)
content: Gain an indefinite Bong Buff, increasing the base duration of Doctor Bong's Heavy Proficiency Buff by +10 seconds. Max stacks: 3. Any Bong Buffs gained while already at max stacks grants 3 personal Reverb Buffs.
Inflict a Stun Debuff for a fixed 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Ask Not For Whom the Bong Tolls
content: When Doctor Bong would be struck by a Combo-Ending Attack, he executes a Reversal. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
Doctor Bong's Heavy Proficiency Buff gains [10 - 25]% increased potency.
